scope: Standard binary SDK; an implementation capability is not a device validation result. Features absent from this catalog are unclassified.

render.portable-view.description: Bounded 2D rectangular sprites, text/actions and audio cues from PortableView state. Native Sprite and Canvas hosts share the same C# rules, without native 3D feature parity.

game.shared-session.description: Shared C# IGameSession rules; presentation and platform services are provided by adapters.

script.scene-behaviour.description: C# ScriptBehaviour attached to a native scene. Portable hosts do not execute the native scene graph.

audio.native-control.description: Native 2D/spatial playback, bus gain, pause/resume, seek and listener controls. PortableView audio cues have a separate adapter contract. Device availability must be checked at runtime.

render.native-scene.description: Native scene renderer; Web and WeChat require a separate presentation adapter.

game.project-adapter.description: Project-supplied presentation/export adapter. Its existence does not prove feature parity or device correctness.

script.custom-native.description: Project C++ or extra native plugins require a separately built matching player, outside the standard binary SDK.

ai.development-session.description: Isolated native development player with input, frame stepping, inspection and capture; excluded from Shipping.
